in_tamil.name: வேத்ராஜ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: வேத் (vēt) - ஜனன் (janan) - people ராஜ் (rāj) - வித்தியவர் (vittiyavar) - knowledgeable person, expert

in_marathi.name: Vedraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vedraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vedraj is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Veda' which means knowledge and 'Raj' which means king. The name signifies a wise and knowledgeable ruler.

in_bengali.name: Vedraj
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Knowledge, Wisdom
in_bengali.long_meaning: Vedraj একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Vedraj is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Veda' which means knowledge and 'Raj' which means king. The name signifies a wise and knowledgeable ruler.
